name: craft-human-agent-language
job: Write or review a human-agent document or prompt: purpose, audience, structure, plain language, evidence-based language, output contract, re-verification.

inScope: Framing purpose and audience before writing
Structuring headings, lists, examples, and schemas
Choosing language and format from dated evidence, never hardcoded model truth
Defining an output contract at the boundary and a verification gate
outOfScope: Hardcoding a fixed model ranking as truth
Over-constraining reasoning output with forced schemas
Publishing dated tokenizer measurements as durable doctrine

inputs: Existing draft or empty artifact and token/parse constraints
Current dated language and tokenizer evidence
outputs: Written or reviewed artifact with structure-first layout
Recorded language/format decision and its evidence basis
Verification-gate results and refresh note for dated evidence

data: dated language/tokenizer evidence for the target model family

failureSemantics: Language and format claims are only as fresh as their dated evidence; a gate runs before committing unknown-model choices, and any hardcoded model ranking is treated as stale until re-measured.

outcome.observable: A document or prompt with explicit purpose/audience, structure before prose, plain-language floors, a recorded evidence-based language/format decision, and a re-verification gate that an independent reviewer can rerun.
